summary: Animates a property smoothly when its value changes, for example on :hover.
details: Shorthand for the property to watch, the duration, the timing function and a delay. Put it on the element’s normal state, not on :hover, so the change animates both ways. List several, comma-separated, for different properties.

values.note: Smooth movement, e.g. a hover lift.
Two properties, each with its own timing.
Everything that changes; convenient but can animate more than you meant.

gotcha: Only properties with in-between values can transition: colours, lengths, transforms, opacity. display, and changes to or from auto (height: auto), jump instead of animating.
